claim_tested: Do NLP-29-family peptides kill by membrane disruption?
key_finding: SYTOX green showed no B. pseudomallei membrane disruption by synthetic NLP-31; gel retardation showed DNA binding and loss of viability.
context: synthetic peptide, B. pseudomallei, SYTOX green + gel retardation, in vitro
confidence: high for NLP-31; moderate when transferred to NLP-29
limitations: Tests NLP-31, not NLP-29. Peptide species assayed is the predicted mature region, not the individually amidated hexa/octapeptides. Single bacterial species.

claim_tested: Does the GO:0140912 reference support membrane destabilizing activity?
key_finding: NLP-29::mKate2 knock-in is secreted into the cuticle after wounding. No membrane assay is reported.
context: C. elegans, knock-in fluorescent reporter, in vivo imaging
confidence: high for localisation, none for mechanism
limitations: Cited as NAS support for GO:0140912 although it contains no biophysical or membrane-permeabilisation experiment.

claim_tested: Is nlp-29 individually required for antifungal resistance?
key_finding: nlp-29(tm1931) null shows no marked change in resistance to D. coniospora; resistance gain comes from overexpression of the whole six-gene cluster.
context: C. elegans, D. coniospora infection, loss-of-function and overexpression
limitations: Redundancy among five near-identical paralogs can mask a single-gene requirement, so this does not exclude a contribution.

evidence_type: primary, discovery of the nlp-29 cluster
claim_tested: Is nlp-29 an infection-induced putative antimicrobial peptide gene?
key_finding: nlp-29 is strongly induced by D. coniospora infection as part of a TLR-independent response.
context: C. elegans, fungal infection, expression profiling
limitations: Induction is IEP-grade evidence for a defense response. It does not identify a molecular mechanism.

claim_tested: Does an NLP-29-family peptide act through a GPCR?
key_finding: NPR-12 is implicated as a receptor in the neuronal response involving this peptide family.
limitations: Receptor engagement by the specific amidated NLP-29 peptides is not shown by direct binding.

claim_tested: What is the physiological context of nlp-29 induction?
key_finding: nlp-29 expression is a readout of epidermal damage and cuticle integrity signalling.
limitations: Places nlp-29 downstream in a damage response without assigning a molecular function.

claim_tested: Are the mature NLP-29 peptides experimentally established?
key_finding: All six Peptide features and all six amidation sites are ECO:0000255 (predicted). Protein existence is PE=2, transcript level.
confidence: high that the features are predicted, none that they are observed
limitations: No MS, no Edman, no synthetic-peptide report for any individual NLP-29 peptide.

claim_tested: Do the predicted mature peptides fall in membrane-lytic AMP space?
key_finding: In-silico processing reproduced UniProt 6/6: QWGYGGY-NH2, GYGGYGGY-NH2, GMYGGY-NH2 x3, GMYGGW-NH2. Length 6-8 aa, zero charged side chains, net +0.99 from the alpha-amino group alone, muH 0.045-0.236, Gly+Pro 0.43-0.63, max extended length 20-27 A against a ~30 A bilayer core. z vs 12 lytic AMPs: frac cationic -2.80, muH -2.38 to -3.59, charge -1.45. P(lytic) 0.047-0.071 vs lytic median 0.814. Nearest neighbours Met- and Leu-enkephalin.
context: Eisenberg scale, 100 deg periodicity, logistic classifier LOO accuracy 0.77 vs 0.54 baseline
confidence: high as a prediction, conditional on the processing model
limitations: Conditional on a proteolysis that has never been observed. Sequence-based descriptors do not capture aggregation, Tyr-mediated interfacial binding or oligomerisation.

claim_tested: How robust is the non-lytic verdict?
key_finding: Median P(lytic) is 0.021-0.086 for full processing but 0.946-0.997 for any model leaving the pro-region intact and 0.301-0.423 for partial processing. Scale choice shifts the median by at most 0.053 within a model.
limitations: The classifier is trained on 30 benchmark peptides and gives a ranking, not a calibrated probability of biological lysis.

claim_tested: Is NLP-31 physicochemically representative of NLP-29?
key_finding: Pro-region length 53 vs 51, net charge +5.98 vs +5.98, Arg 5 vs 5, Lys 1 vs 1, Gly fraction 0.528 vs 0.510. The RRR stretch belongs to nlp-27 (O44666), the least cationic member at +3.98.
limitations: UniProt accession-to-symbol order and GO WBGene labels for nlp-27 vs nlp-31 are not reconciled here; see Conflicts and Alternatives.
